description.full_text: The image shows a group of people meditating in a serene, spacious room with soft lighting. They are seated on purple mats in a row, with some using additional cushions. The participants, both men and women, are dressed comfortably, and their eyes are closed, focusing on meditation. Several candles and a small bowl are placed on the floor in the foreground, adding to the calm atmosphere. The walls have minimal decor, including framed text. Overall, the mood is peaceful and contemplative.
